en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/138@0/d: Which of the following most closely matches your overall campaign message?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/197@1/d: What is your opinion on measures that would aim to restrict the sale or production of alcohol?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/142@2/d:
You have very little chance of winning New York this fall, and nearly all of that city's newspapers are anti-Bryan. That doesn't mean you couldn't draw a frenzied crowd in New York City.
Perhaps the media attention would be beneficial in building excitement for your campaign on a national scale?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/195@3/d: The United States is in the midst of a financial calamity, with masses of unemployed men on the streets. What will you do to revive business in this country?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/139@4/d: What do you have to say about William McKinley's campaign, at a high level?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/194@5/d: What is your definitive position on the tariff issue?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/193@6/d: Can you state your definitive position on the American monetary system?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/196@7/d: Grover Cleveland sent federal troops to Illinois to end the Pullman Strike without the request of Governor Altgeld. Was this an overreach on his part?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/148@8/d: What do you think of leaving the Midwest for a week and making a circuit of the crucial upper South states? (i.e. Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, and Kentucky)
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/141@9/d:
The novelty of a personal visit from the "Great Commoner" could probably swing the West Coast states in your direction. However, it will take two weeks to travel and return via train.
Will you divert your attention from the Midwest long enough to visit California, Oregon, and Washington?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/145@10/:
You have alluded to the need for less prejudice between the races. Senator "Pitchfork" Ben Tillman, of South Carolina, privately seeks your clarification.
Can you reassure him that the federal government will respect the rights of the states under your Administration?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/226@11/: What are your views on the Darwinian theory of Evolution?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/151@12/:
The respectable city newspapers are unanimously pro-McKinley. As such, William Randolph Hearst senses that supporting you would be a terrific business opportunity.
Can you reassure him that there are limits to your pacifist ideals, particularly in regards to Cuba?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/146@13/: Governor Altgeld of Illinois has proposed that you appear with him in Chicago for a couple of big speeches. Later on he would appear with you in southern Illinois to solidify his support with rural voters. What do you think of this idea?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/217@14/: A few western states have allowed women the right to vote. Do you take the calls for a women's suffrage Amendment seriously?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/216@15/: Should there be some regulation of working hours for children, particularly those under the age of 12 or 13?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/171@16/: John Palmer, a Gold Democrat, is also running against Bryan. He has offered to remove his name from the ballot on the East and West Coast if you will do the same in the South. He argues that this will consolidate the anti-Bryan vote. What do you think?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/221@17/: What are your thoughts on the Women's Christian Temperance Union? Is this group a positive force in American life?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/237@18/: Do you think that there should be federal oversight of the New York and Chicago trading markets?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/244@19/: Do you approve of Grover Cleveland's handing of the federal budget over the previous four years?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/143@20/: New York politics are dominated by a highly corrupt, patronage-based outfit known as Tammany Hall. Their boss, Richard Croker, has so far been indifferent to your campaign. Are you willing to make concessions to arouse his enthusiasm?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/152@21/: Without compromising on the silver issue, what can you say about McKinley to Bourbon Democrats to try and bring them back into the fold?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/219@22/: Would you support a program to compensate workers who are injured on the job? Is this a proper responsibility of the federal government?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/149@23/: You are making a big speech in Chicago today. What points will you touch on?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/questions_json/251@24/: There is one week left until election day. Every state is important, but where will you give an extra push with your personal campaigning to swing the final results?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1479@0/de: I am a proud "wet" in the alcohol debate. What a man drinks is no one's business but his own.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/976@1/des: We support the free coinage of silver priced at a 16-to-1 ratio against gold. The results will aid farmers and workers of all classes and contribute to an American renewal.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/977@2/des: We will focus on free-silver and especially on the issues affecting farmers. We will seek a reduction in private debts and an end to the monopolistic practices of the railroads. We will also fight for the lowest possible tariffs.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/978@3/des: Silver coinage is just one part of my platform. Let's not forget the struggles of the urban worker in his efforts to unionize and obtain fair wages.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/979@4/des: I am 100% committed to the coinage of silver. It's important however, that we strike a moderate tone on other issues to expand our appeal as widely as we can.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/980@5/des: McKinley is a fanatical defender of an obsolete monetary system. He is a front-man for big business and the New York financiers.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/981@6/des: McKinley's support of high tariffs is a crime which strangles American commerce. Similar protectionist programs have twice been rejected by American voters in the past ten years alone.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/982@7/des: We may have our disagreements, but William McKinley is an honorable man. Our campaign will focus on the issues, not on the opponent.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/983@8/des: McKinley's insistence on the gold standard has alienated many prominent Republicans from his own party, such as Henry Teller.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/989@9/des: Let us bring our message to the citizens of the Pacific Coast. Winning these three states could swing the entire election.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/990@10/de: Let's keep the tour as short as possible. I will take a train to San Francisco and deliver a few speeches in that city, but will not tour the entire coast.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/991@11/de: There is no time for that diversion. Heaven knows what rumors McKinley will spread while I am gone, and winning the Midwest should be our primary focus.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/992@12/de: New York is a traditional Democratic stronghold, and I'm confident that the people of that state will support my message. We will campaign there extensively.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/993@13/de: Let's not waste our time in a hostile state. We must sow our seed upon the good earth where it will multiply.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/994@14/de: I will give one big speech in New York City to open my campaign. Even if winning that state is hopeless, we need the national press.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/995@15/de: Corrupt organizations such as Tammany Hall drag the good name of the Democrats through the dirt. I would never debase my Christian ideals for their support.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/996@16/de: Croker is probably worried about my views on the temperance issue. I will assure him that a Bryan Administration will not push for Prohibition.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/997@17/de: I'm sure that Croker is concerned about the patronage positions his men will receive. Patronage jobs for New York men will be plentiful in my administration.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/998@18/de: Perhaps there is a misunderstanding. I will defend labor unions, fight against the temperance movements, and ensure adequate patronage jobs for New York Democrats. All I ask in return is that they deliver New York to the ticket.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1002@19/d: We will respect the rights of the states. I call for greater understanding, but certainly not for an overthrow of the natural order.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1003@20/d: There has been a deafening silence for many years on the issue of equal rights in the South. It's time we had a true enforcement of the 14th and 15th Amendment.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1004@21/d: Tillman and others have nothing to fear from me. It is the sacred duty of the white man to properly instruct and civilize the black man and other inferior races. Greater understanding must occur within this context.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1005@22/d: Altgeld is free to appear with me at any event, but I will not rearrange my entire schedule to suit his needs.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1006@23/d: On many industrial issues, such as the Pullman Strike and his pardon of the Haymarket anarchists, Altgeld is too radical. I would prefer not to appear with him.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1007@24/d: This sounds like a good idea. Farmers and other laborers need to be unified this fall if we're to have a chance of beating McKinley.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1011@25/d: We need to keep it simple. Our primary goal in this campaign is to win the critical states of Iowa, Illinois, and Indiana.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1012@26/d: It's a shame that we need to even campaign in these beacons of the South. But if we have to, let us do it with effluence.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1013@27/d: I will make my standard stump speech highlighting the dangers of the gold standard and advocating for free silver.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1014@28/d: Let's hit on the issue of tariffs. These voters need to be reminded that tariffs increase the cost of farm equipment and other manufactured goods.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1015@29/d: I will speak to the general issues of the future -- free silver, higher wages, worker's rights, an end to child labor, and women's suffrage.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1016@30/d: I am a moderate who supports the free coinage of silver. I am not a radical as so many claim. It is McKinley's antiquated insistence on the gold standard that is truly radical.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1019@31/d: I cannot support the exploitation of foreign peoples in good conscience. The Bible states that thou shalt not kill, and that is my position as well.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1020@32/d: William Randolph Hearst knows my opinions and he is free to endorse me or not endorse me. I will not cater to his whims.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1021@33/d: New York and California are important states, and of course I support the uplift of primitive peoples with American influence. What's not to like in this arrangement?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1022@34/d: McKinley has proposed some of the most dastardly tariffs to ever see the light of day in this country.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1023@35/d: McKinley will run a radical pro-monopolist Administration that should frighten any ordinary American.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1024@36/d: We can all agree that the growth in the deficit is concerning. I will fight for an income tax Amendment that will allow us to close this gap without increasing tariffs.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1025@37/d: With the new perspectives I bring, I will be in a unique position to ensure clean, honest government at the federal level. McKinley, on the other hand, is a Republican hack who will continue the status quo.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1372@38/d: Absolutely not. Can you imagine how it would look if we removed ourselves from the ticket in any state? And for an old man like Palmer?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1373@39/d: If Palmer will remove himself from the ballot in Kentucky, Indiana, West Virginia, Maryland, and Delaware, then I will give him free reign in the Deep South.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1374@40/d: I hope Palmer will see fit to remove himself unilaterally from the most hotly contested border states. His is purely a protest candidacy however, and I cannot remove myself from a ballot on his behalf without looking like a buffoon.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1375@41/d: I am willing to make an expansive deal with Palmer. He may remain on the ballot in Illinois, but must remove himself completely from the other northern states. In turn I will give him free reign in the entire South.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1460@42/d: I support a strict adherence to the gold standard, which is fundamental to American prosperity.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1461@43/d: Limited silver coinage is a good compromise. I support a program like that of Bland-Allison where the government purchases around $2 million of silver each month.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1462@44/d: I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at the current market price of 30-to-1 against gold. This ratio should be frequently adjusted to match actual prices in order to avoid another run on the Treasury's gold supply.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1463@45/d: I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at a fixed price ratio of 16-to-1 against gold.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1464@46/d: Tariffs should be limited to the minimum amount necessary to raise sufficient revenue for the federal government.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1465@47/d: In limited areas where we have new industries forming, tariffs can be higher. They should be low on most products.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1466@48/d: Where we have mature, stable industries, tariffs can be lower. They should be high on most products.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1467@49/d: We need high tariffs on a variety of products and commodities to stimulate American manufacturing.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1468@50/d: The Democratic idea has been that if you legislate to make the masses prosperous, their prosperity will find its way up through every class which rests upon them. We need to help our farmers and our workers by allowing the coinage of silver.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1469@51/d: It's time we think about implementing a series of public works projects to occupy our excess labor force. This will improve business by placing more money in the hands of consumers.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1470@52/d: I can't stress this enough. The most important thing we can do right now is increase our tariffs to protect American business.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1471@53/d: We need to reaffirm our commitment to non-intervention in business affairs. Companies need stability before they will have the confidence to expand.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1472@54/d: This was the act of a tyrant. Pullman was engaged in abominable business practices, and in the darkest hour Cleveland cast his lot with the company over the working man.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1473@55/d: Governor Altgeld was working to mediate the dispute between the Pullman Company and the strikers when Cleveland interfered. There should have absolutely been more time given for these sides to reach an accommodation.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1474@56/d: It's not the job of government to regulate labor disputes, but the fact of the matter is that these strikers were allowing no rail traffic to pass through Chicago whatsoever. Something needed to be done.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1475@57/d: Bargaining for wages is the business of a man and his employer. Collective bargaining has no place in American society, and I commend Grover Cleveland for having the courage to act decisively.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1476@58/d: It is my dream to see a Prohibition Amendment passed before I die.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1477@59/d: These measures are a step in the right direction. Nothing destroys so many lives in this country as does the pernicious habit of drinking alcohol.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1478@60/d: Perhaps if our goal is to prevent drinking on Sunday, or public drunkenness, I am all for those measures. But a blanket temperance law is a different story.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1536@61/d: It agonizes me that we do not have this protection in place. Have we not seen children who are seven years old losing their hands in the cotton looms?
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1537@62/d: I believe this is warranted in the industrial trades. Let us not forget that all hands are needed on the farm, not least of all in this day and age.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1538@63/d: It falls outside the scope of the Constitution for the federal government to regulate the working conditions within a factory. This is not something that the President has control over.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1539@64/d: I would support such an Amendment if it gained traction within our system. I'm just sorry to see that the chances seem unlikely.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1540@65/d: We welcome the support of women and men. Where women are granted the vote, we are confident that they will support our ticket.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1541@66/d: I think there are more important issues for us to be focusing our efforts on. Extending the suffrage to women carries with it a whole host of dangers.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1545@67/d: We absolutely need a federal program for this purpose. The Bible says that we must love all people -- even those who have been cast aside by our Darwinian industrial machinery.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1546@68/d: This is more properly a state responsibility. It is outside the scope of the federal government to regulate working conditions in this manner.

en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1552@70/d: The WCTU is one of the most spiritually uplifting, morally righteous groups in our society. I pray that the Lord will see fit to guide them to success in their mission.

en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1554@72/d: This group is Exhibit A in the dangers of allowing women to become politically active. They are engaged in a naive quest to purify American life from an imagined evil.

en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1570@76/d: Evolution teaches disregard for the security and dignity of our fellow man. Left unchecked this 'survival of the fittest' mentality will eventually cause indifference to life itself, from which only calamity can ensue.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1602@77/d: The poor man is called a socialist if he believes that the wealth of the rich should be divided among the poor, but the rich man is called a financier if he devises a plan by which the pittance of the poor can be converted to his use.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1603@78/d: It was stock market and railroad company chicanery which caused the Panic of 1893. Sensible regulation of this process could have saved us all a lot of trouble.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1604@79/d: The New York Stock Exchange is a private company providing liquidity to other companies. The last thing our fragile economy needs is some hare-brained intervention in this process.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1605@80/d: There has already been considerable reform of the stock markets since the dangerous days of the 1860s. There's no need to take this idea any further.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1624@81/d: Grover Cleveland has vetoed more pieces of legislation than any President in our history, increased our deficit, and still found a way to provide J.P. Morgan with a financial windfall from the public purse.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1625@82/d: Is there anyone left in the United States who approves of Grover Cleveland? We need to move on from his failed Administration.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1626@83/d: Grover Cleveland is a citizen of integrity who has done his best under trying circumstances. He was simply found to be not up to the job.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1627@84/d: I will stand up for Grover Cleveland for the rest of my life. I believe that he is a great man whom our history will greatly vindicate.
en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1648@85/d: Let's spend the entire week in Illinois. That is the largest state that we have a chance to win.

en.1896_Bryan_Teller/answers_json/1652@89/d: We must secure the upper South. This means we start in in Maryland and Delaware, move through Virginia and West Virginia, and then through Kentucky.
